description: List the download files that split a served dataset's newest version by one field, such as one file per year. Use it to hand someone a slice of the data as a file. It gives file links and no rows, so to answer a question use query_rows or count_rows instead, and for the whole table as one file use get_dataset. field must be one of the partition_by fields that list_fields names, and any other field returns a 404 error. Every value comes back in one answer, with no paging. The call costs nothing against the rate limit.

field.description: A partition field named in the data package, for example crash_year or loc_local_government_area

name: list_partitions

partitions.description: One entry per value: the value, its row count and the URL of a JSON file with every row holding it

version_base.description: The version these files belong to

title: List partition files
